For **spiritual practice** alongside shadow work, the most relevant option in your results is **Insight Timer’s “Shadow Work: Embrace Your Full Self For Healing And Growth,”** since Insight Timer is primarily a meditation and mindfulness platform, which makes it a better fit if you want the practice to connect with contemplative work.[11]

A few lower-cost or broader alternatives also show up in the results, including several **Udemy** courses and the **Centre of Excellence** “Shadow Mastery” course, but these appear more generic and less specialized than the options above.[3][5][9][13][15][16]
